selected.title: Read concatenated Zstandard frames without dropping member data (R3.12)
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Decode concatenated Zstandard frames under one cumulative output limit.
selected.summary_zh: 完整解码连续的 Zstandard 帧，并对总输出统一限额。
selected.technical_value: Processes each compressed frame until input is exhausted, skips length-framed skippable records and shares the same capped writer across all data frames.
selected.test_evidence: The merged test decodes two valid frames around a skippable record, verifies exact output, enforces the combined byte limit and rejects truncated second or skippable frames.
selected.limitations: Covers the bounded Zstandard decompressor used for archive members.

selected.title: Require a rejecting branch before labelling EVM dispatch nonpayable (R3.12)
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Require a branch that rejects nonzero value before labeling an EVM dispatcher nonpayable.
selected.summary_zh: 只有发现拒绝非零转账的分支时，才将 EVM 分发逻辑标记为不可支付。
selected.technical_value: Recognizes direct and inverted CALLVALUE guard patterns and follows the rejecting path. Limits a dispatcher-wide conclusion to a guard on its straight-line entry path.
selected.test_evidence: Synthetic bytecode distinguishes a value read from a real rejecting guard, covers both branch directions and checks that a non-rejecting or unrelated path does not set a global nonpayable flag.
selected.limitations: The bytecode analyzer recognizes bounded control-flow patterns. It does not execute contracts or establish a general proof of payability.

selected.title: Keep filesystem and archive recovery within recorded boundaries (R3.12)
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Respect declared image and record boundaries during filesystem and archive recovery.
selected.summary_zh: 在文件系统与归档恢复时遵守镜像和记录声明的边界。
selected.technical_value: Limits cramfs directory reads, JFFS2 nodes, ROMFS images and SquashFS structures to their recorded extents and validates length-framed PAX metadata in tar archives.
selected.test_evidence: Synthetic images exercise adjacent bytes, truncated nodes, empty directories, symlink budgets, partially retained extents and malformed PAX length boundaries.
selected.limitations: The merged change covers five reader paths with synthetic recovery fixtures.

selected.title: Protect the selected restore point during backup retention
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Keep a backup selected for a pending restore until the restore marker clears.
selected.summary_zh: 在待恢复标记清除前保留已选定的备份。
selected.technical_value: Retention excludes a staged restore point from deletion. Listing and retention also require a regular snapshot file, and cleanup targets only managed partial snapshots.
selected.test_evidence: Temporary-directory fixtures stage an older restore point, run retention before and after the marker is cleared, test cleanup boundaries and check a directory with a snapshot-like name cannot evict the last real backup.
selected.limitations: Covers snapshot selection and filesystem retention, without testing a full server restore.

selected.title: Preserve deliverable revisions that share a short content hash
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Preserve distinct deliverable revisions when their abbreviated hashes collide.
selected.summary_zh: 保留短哈希前缀相同但内容不同的文件版本。
selected.technical_value: Reserves filenames atomically and checks full digests before reusing an existing stored file.
selected.test_evidence: A pair of equal-length files sharing eight SHA-256 hex digits must both retain their bytes. A second fixture checks the fallback when hard linking is unavailable.
selected.limitations: The tests cover the local deliverable store.

selected.title: Preserve generation progress and skip inference on idempotent PostgreSQL writes
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Retain generation progress and skip repeated embedding work on idempotent PostgreSQL writes.
selected.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 幂等重试保留生成状态，并跳过重复的嵌入推理。
selected.technical_value: Preserves generation status when a repeated session upsert omits it and claims the generation key before embedding newly submitted memories.
selected.test_evidence: The route test spies on the embedder and asserts one call for two writes with the same key. The storage test confirms a repeated session creation preserves completed status and an explicitly requested transition still works.
selected.limitations: The reviewed tests exercise the PostgreSQL storage path.

selected.title: Reduce noncontiguous model gradients
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Reduce noncontiguous PyTorch gradients across distributed workers.
selected.summary_zh: 分布式归约支持非连续布局的 PyTorch 梯度。
selected.technical_value: Flattens gradient tensors with reshape before all-reduce so strided gradients from channels-last convolutions can be synchronized.
selected.test_evidence: Two CPU/Gloo processes compare every parameter gradient against the average of distinct local backwards and check the channels-last gradient layout.

selected.title: Propagate JAX worker failures and validate launch topology
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Return failing JAX worker exit codes to the parent launcher and validate launch topology.
selected.summary_zh: 将 JAX 工作进程的退出码传回父启动器，并校验启动拓扑。
selected.technical_value: Propagates command and multiprocessing worker exit or signal status, validates argument ranges and brackets IPv6 coordinator addresses.
selected.test_evidence: Subprocess tests cover a successful worker, explicit failure, a killed command, a killed worker and IPv6 coordinator configuration.
selected.limitations: The tests exercise process behavior without a distributed accelerator cluster.

selected.title: Restore bearing-aware cheirality for DLT triangulation
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Check triangulation cheirality along each observed ray for spherical cameras.
selected.summary_zh: 沿观测射线判断正深度，修复球面相机三角测量的有效点判定。
selected.technical_value: Uses the dot product of each camera-frame 3D point with its corresponding bearing in two-view DLT, allowing observations behind the camera’s z plane.
selected.test_evidence: Synthetic tests cover front and rear hemispheres, opposing cameras, rescaled bearings, false antipodal matches, pixel noise and 3D/reprojection tolerances.
selected.limitations: The change is specific to the two-view DLT validity check.

selected.title: fix(augmentation): register dispatcher sequences as child modules
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Register dispatcher augmentations as PyTorch child modules and load legacy checkpoints.
selected.summary_zh: 将增强分发器中的流水线注册为 PyTorch 子模块，并兼容旧检查点。
selected.technical_value: Uses ModuleList and a version-aware load hook so mode, dtype, device and parameter traversal reach the children without masking missing state in current checkpoints.
selected.test_evidence: Tests cover eval mode, parameter registration, strict legacy loading, current missing keys, lazy state and non-tensor extra state.
selected.limitations: Covers the many-to-one and many-to-many augmentation dispatchers.

selected.title: fix(metrics): accumulate half-precision meter updates in float32
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Accumulate FP16 and BF16 metric updates in FP32 before multiplying by the weight.
selected.summary_zh: 在加权前先将 FP16/BF16 指标提升为 FP32，防止低精度累积丢失。
selected.technical_value: Casts low-precision inputs before weighting and lets subsequent wider values promote the accumulator.
selected.test_evidence: Regressions check repeated increments, overflow during weighting and promotion by later updates.
selected.limitations: Changes AverageMeter accumulation while preserving the most recent raw input.

selected.title: Preserve tangent vectors in canonical Stiefel projection
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Correct canonical Stiefel projection, Cayley initial velocity and the line-search derivative.
selected.summary_zh: 修正典范 Stiefel 流形的投影、Cayley 曲线初速度与线搜索导数。
selected.technical_value: Separates tangent projection from Riemannian gradient conversion and differentiates the actual Cayley retraction for Wolfe line search.
selected.test_evidence: Tests check projection idempotence, preservation of tangent momentum, retraction Jacobian–vector products against autograd and Wolfe derivatives against finite differences.
selected.limitations: Manifolds without a retraction differential retain the existing transported-direction approximation.

selected.title: Support Euclidean norms with more than two manifold dimensions
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.summary_en: Compute Euclidean norms and distances over all declared manifold dimensions.
selected.summary_zh: 按声明的全部流形维度计算欧氏范数与距离。
selected.technical_value: Uses a vector-norm reduction over the manifold axes while retaining the outer batch shape.
selected.test_evidence: Tests cover three- and four-dimensional manifolds, keepdim and dtype behavior, reference gradients, and finite zero gradients at zero.
selected.limitations: Applies to the Euclidean manifold implementation.

adoption_interval.method: Checked every maintainer/other-author merged PR at the four previous adoption upstreams, the PR and merge commit authors, every listed PR commit author and Afloat co-author trailer, and PR body references against the closed Afloat16 inventory. Three additional CARLA merges and the decline on CARLA #10190 were checked separately.

selection_evaluation.selection_policy: One row per project, one to three distinct directly merged author PRs. Reviewed final commit patches for all in-window eligible candidates and favored the newest substantial batch within each project when several changes qualified, then weighed concrete correctness or data-integrity impact, technical depth and implemented regression coverage. Tests were inspected without local reruns. Host time and upstream stars do not determine relative technical merit.

alternative_review.storytold/craft-anything: Compared all 86 in-window merges. All three selected examples landed on 9 November. #1340 restores potentially lost frame data under a cumulative budget, #1323 corrects a contract-analysis inference and #1246 spans five image and archive readers. #1338 has tested overlap handling but makes an implementation optimization for already correctly decoded LZ4 blocks. #1257 is a strong single-format alternative. Earlier #557 and #438 fell outside the latest substantial batch.
alternative_review.thedotmack/claude-mem: Compared storage and backup fixes #5532, #5536, #5537, #5538 and #5539, stream framing #5367 and sync #5525. The selected patches landed within 47 minutes of one another. They target deletion of a staged restore point, a reproducible digest-prefix collision and repeated PostgreSQL writes. #5525 is an earlier same-day filesystem integrity alternative.
alternative_review.Toni-SM/skrl: Both in-window PRs selected. They affect different distributed backends and include process-level regressions.
alternative_review.openMVG/openMVG: The single eligible change corrects the geometric validity test in the triangulation algorithm. The spherical-camera fixtures exercise observable 3D and reprojection errors with exact, perturbed and antipodal observations.
alternative_review.kornia/kornia: #6449 handles module lifecycle, state and checkpoint migration. #6580 fixes arithmetic before weighting. #6582 covers a narrower NumPy dtype conversion.
alternative_review.geoopt/geoopt: #280 repairs several linked geometric invariants with independent autograd and finite-difference checks. #278 covers a distinct norm/distance failure with checked gradients. #279 addresses a narrower origin batch-shape regression.
alternative_review.KevinMusgrave/pytorch-metric-learning: #775 and #776 compare low-precision loss values and gradients against wider references. They are strong alternates. The six homepage rows prioritize distributed failures, filesystem and storage integrity, and geometry, while Kornia already represents an accumulation failure. #777–779 address singleton regularization, sampling and a benchmark.
alternative_review.morluto/rea: #8907 tests truncated UTF-8 under every split, #8909 preserves pending NDJSON frames and #8908 checks cancellation after a bounded read. The engineering is focused on transport and diagnostic boundaries. Scope and regression evidence were compared with the selected core state, storage and mathematical changes.
alternative_review.mikedh/trimesh: #2618 corrects the covariance used for nonuniform weighted rotation, with replicated-correspondence and rank-deficient controls. It merged into release/angles. The geometry rows feature work on the default branches with wider camera and optimizer coverage.
alternative_review.huggingface/sentence-transformers: #4323 masks padded token embeddings before CNN convolution and tests padding invariance. Earlier LambdaLoss, quantization and LSTM selections fall outside the window. The recent fix addresses one encoding path.
alternative_review.JetBrains/thinkrail: #1184 and #1185 improve format sniffing; #1186 handles Unicode in terminal truncation. All have targeted tests. Their scope is narrower than the selected projects’ changes.
alternative_review.colmap/colmap: The high-impact translation-angle correction #4932 lies outside the rolling window. #4975–4977 address a tutorial, dataset script paths and a Flickr downloader rather than the reconstruction solver.
alternative_review.serengil/deepface: The four eligible contributions cover HTTP option parsing, FTP filenames, Unicode local paths and response cleanup. Older inference and vector-search contributions fall outside the window.
alternative_review.recommenders-team/recommenders: #2419 preserves custom columns in stratified splits and has seeded-order checks. It landed on staging and addresses the splitter’s schema contract.
alternative_review.elalish/manifold: #1905 isolates static convex-hull construction from attached input contexts and tests cached errors and progress. The other geometry selections address central validity and differentiation invariants with a wider set of controls.
alternative_review.carla-simulator/carla: #10188 and #10189 correct useful documentation on matrix basis conversion and packed depth. #10191 changes the tutorial’s error message. None of the three final commits changed simulator implementation or added a regression test.
